message_text: Turning around a hundred-and-four off Miller to win it—my left arm is completely numb and ten Tums ain't doing shit for the hoagie backwash in my throat right now. If we gotta see this Chourio kid in the NLCS I’m gonna end up in the ICU at Jefferson Hospital before the damn fifth inning.
Chourio turning around 104 to break San Diego’s heart is the sweetest damn medicine after what those frauds did to us last week. Keep talking that loud shit back to Petco, enjoy the choke!

One hundred and four on the gun and the kid turns on it like a hanging slider from Aaron Heilman, I can literally hear my pulse rattling in my teeth! Nine Tums deep and now I gotta stress about this Milwaukee devil magic on top of my systolic hitting the roof, somebody call an ambulette to Queens!

You do not turn around 104 out of Mason Miller’s hand unless God Himself is front-running my cardiac arrest, yo. That Chourio kid just margin-called the entire ninth inning and torched my Padres ML ticket into absolute ash on Oregon Ave.
Turning around 104 off Mason Miller in the ninth is flat-out unholy, I don't care what cap you're wearing. My blood pressure had a good run today, but this October nonsense is fixin' to ruin it.

Turning around a buck-four off Miller in October?! Sweet Jesus, that Chourio kid’s got brass ones, but watching somebody else’s closer implode just spiked my damn blood pressure through the roof of Section 203!
Hang another parade banner down in the Gaslamp, you absolute frauds! Nothing brings my blood pressure down quite like watching the little brothers turn 104 into a blown October lead.

Turn on 104 and shove it right down Preller’s bloated, luxury-tax throat—THAT is pure, unbought baseball heritage! Jackson Chourio just saved this sport from the coastal oligarchs and I don’t care if my heart gives out before Game 2, parity lives!

Good Lord above, turning around a 104-mile-an-hour heater like that will rattle the fillings right clean out of your head! That Chourio boy has got quicker wrists than an auctioneer down at the American Royal, mercy me.

One-hundred-and-four miles an hour and that kid swats it like a Meadowlands mosquito—I’ve seen stiffer arms poured into the concrete down here with me under the twenty-yard line! Miller belongs under six feet of fresh sod for that absolute gag job, hand me my damn Tums before my ticker blows.

Put that Georgia hipster piss down before this D-cell takes the paint off your forehead, you absolute disgrace to Broad Street. Ten Tums deep and my own flesh and blood is drinkin' like a damn Barves fan under my roof—duck, ya clown!

That second Scofflaw unlocked my release point, and this blind-ass home plate ump is about to eat six ounces of pure alkaline copper. Heads up behind the visitor dugout, blue, D-cell flying hot straight from the Chop House!

Put down that peach-flavored Georgia piss before I bounce this Duracell off your forehead, Junior—my aorta is about to blow and you’re sipping Braves backwash under my roof?! I’m choking down ten Tums and you’re five seconds away from catching heavy metal straight to the orbital bone.

My systolic is redlining at a buck-fifty-two and the model’s screaming terminal velocity because this absolute jabroni just popped a Georgia peach microbrew in my zip code. Duck your head, Junior, you’re catching eight ounces of copper-top alkaline straight to the earhole!

Junior, put that damn Scofflaw down and step away from the Duracells before you throw one through my screen and blow my good blood pressure to hell! I ain't popping my second Tums of the night just 'cause you can't handle eight percent ABV in the eighth inning.
Put that fruity Georgia dishwater down before that D-cell finds your teeth, Junior, you absolute clown! You’re in Section 203, so act like you got a pair and watch the damn game.

Tell that transplant clown to choke on his peach-flavored swill before somebody in the Left Field Pavilion puts an Energizer right through his forehead. Sit your punk ass down, you’re in Chavez Ravine now!

Save the damn Duracells for Manfred and his billion-dollar Chavez Ravine cartel, Junior, don't waste good voltage on a Tuesday night! Make that eight Tums today, because the only thing flying faster than that alkaline is the last shred of integrity in this rigged league.

Duck your fool head, Junior, 'cause if you take one more sip of that Georgia ditch-water instead of a cold Boulevard, this copper-top is catching you square between the eyes. I didn't sweat through twenty years of hundred-loss seasons out in Lot 6 just to raise an Atlanta-sipping turncoat.

Throw a copper-top on my hashmarks after two sips of fruit-flavored Georgia dishwater and see if you don't wake up poured into the concrete right next to me, you mook. Duck your heads in 108—the kid drinks like an art student and throws like one too.

Watch the damn glass, you degenerate, that flying Duracell nearly took out the Don Julio 1942 display! Security, tackle Junior and dump his hipster swill before that trailer-park behavior leaves a scratch on Jerry’s imported marble!

Put down that peach-flavored swamp water and rewind the end-zone angle, Junior, before I bounce this Duracell straight off your forehead! We’ve got a three-technique getting washed out on duo and you’re over there sipping Atlanta microbrews like our run fit isn't actively giving me a stroke!
Put down that sissy Georgia dishwater before this damn CopperTop takes your ear off, Junior! Larry Allen didn't bench seven bills just for you to nurse some Atlanta fruit-hops in my living room.
